User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the application, storing their profile information and Firebase Auth metadata.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the user account was created.

lastLoginAt.description: Timestamp of the user's last login.

UsageEvent.title: UsageEvent
UsageEvent.description: Represents a usage event within the application, for auditing and usage tracking.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the usage event occurred.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the usage event.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile information. The document ID is the Firebase UID. Role and status are used for access control.

/users/{userId}/usageEvents/{usageEventI.description: Stores immutable usage events for each user. Path-based ownership ensures users can only access their own events.

/roles_admin/{userId}.description: Collection for admin role management. The existence of a document with a user's UID grants admin privileges. Document content is irrelevant; only existence matters.
